title: Special Order for Pharr Brothers, Inc., ex parte. — Pharr Brothers, Inc., ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 5306-C. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 5306-C hereby is, cancelled.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                         SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 74-2026

                               PHARR BROTHERS, INC.
                                    EX PARTE

                       In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 5306-C
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC No. 5306-C per a notarized
affidavit received on November 20, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC No. 5306-C held
by Pharr Brothers, Inc. is hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees and
fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.

                              (Decided November 20, 2026)




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
November 23, 2026



                                             DISTRICT I
                                             CHAIRMAN ERIC F. SKRMETTA


                                             DISTRICT II
                                             VICE CHAIRMAN JEAN-PAUL P. COUSSAN


                                             DISTRICT V
                                             COMMISSIONER FOSTER L. CAMPBELL


                                             DISTRICT IV
